input.command:
echo "=== Python Files Line Count Report ===" > python_summary.txt
echo "" >> python_summary.txt
echo "Generated: $(date)" >> python_summary.txt
echo "" >> python_summary.txt

total_lines=0
total_files=0

for file in $(find . -name "*.py" -type f | grep -v ".venv" | sort); do
    lines=$(wc -l < "$file")
    total_lines=$((total_lines + lines))
    total_files=$((total_files + 1))
    printf "%-45s %5d lines\n" "$file" "$lines" >> python_summary.txt
done

echo "" >> python_summary.txt
echo "========================================" >> python_summary.txt
printf "Total: %d files, %d lines\n" "$total_files" "$total_lines" >> python_summary.txt
echo "========================================" >> python_summary.txt

cat python_summary.txt
